source_version_note: LaTeX source is a post-v1 arXiv version (has section 'Changes since previous arXiv version': v1 of 11 Dec 2023 'included the list of events from an older version of our pipeline'). Event list here is from this later version; v1 lists differ.

criterion.summary: p_astro > 0.5 (IAS-HM pipeline's own p_astro, which depends on its astrophysical prior); no FAR threshold for detection. Search covers Hanford-Livingston coincident O3 data, BBH only.
criterion.quote: we find 11 new candidate BBH mergers with $0.52\leq p_\mathrm{astro}\leq 0.88$ (we use the detection threshold as the astrophysical probability, $p_\mathrm{astro}$, being over 0.5, following the approach of other pipelines).
criterion.section: Abstract (count via macro \neviasnew=11); restated in Sec. III A 'New candidate events': 'we find 11 candidate events with $p_\mathrm{astro}>0.5$ which have not been previously reported in the literature.'

tiers.name: new (Table I)
tiers.quote: Properties of new candidate events found in our search with $p_{\rm astro} > 0.5$.
tiers.section: Table I caption (tab:NewEvents), Sec. III A

tiers.name: previously reported by IAS (2,2)-only (Table II)
tiers.quote: Same as Table~\ref{tab:NewEvents} but for candidate events with $p_\mathrm{astro}>0.5$ in our search which overlap with those first reported in the IAS $(2, 2)$-only searches
tiers.section: Table II caption; Sec. IV B: 'Overall, we recover 5 events with $\pastro \geq 0.5$.'

tiers.name: previously reported in GWTC-3, recovered (Table III)
tiers.quote: Hanford--Livingston coincident events already reported in the GWTC-3 catalog as detected by our pipeline and the 4-OGC catalog. ... Six GWTC-3 events were detected with $p_\mathrm{astro}<0.5$ in our pipeline (GW190403_051519, GW190917_114630, GW191113_071753, GW200202_154313, GW200208_222617, GW200322_091133).
tiers.section: Table III caption; Sec. IV C (sec:LVC). Included here only rows with IAS-HM p_astro > 0.5 (58 of 68 GWTC-3 rows).

tiers.name: previously reported in 4-OGC only, recovered (Table III bottom)
tiers.quote: we include comparison with the list of 7 events in 4-OGC which are not present in GWTC-3 catalog (from which we recover 5 with $p_\mathrm{astro}>0.5$)

tiers.name: sub-threshold (not detections)
tiers.quote: Same as Table~\ref{tab:NewEvents} but for candidates found with $0.2<p_\mathrm{astro}<0.5$ and IFAR $>$ 1 within the respective bank for the respective observing run (O3a or O3b).
